newsitem.title: USA: Antares to buy United Kina in stock swap.
newsitem.headline: Antares to buy United Kina in stock swap.

text.p: Antares Resources Corp said Tuesday it had signed a definitive agreement with United Kina Breweries Ltd to buy all the issued and outstanding shares of Kina in exchange for previously unissued, restricted, Antares common stock.
The agreement is subject to various terms, including the closing of $5 million in private funding, Antares said.
United Kina Breweries is a privately held Bermuda corporation operating seven breweries.

The agreement requires Antares to effect a reverse split of its common stock on a one-for-ten basis. The company will then issue 33,500,000 post-split, restricted, common shares to Kina stockholders, amounting to about 93 percent of the company's outstanding common stock in exchange for all of Kina's shares.
